A special day for our young leaders. ✨

From taking their oaths to receiving their badges, our students stepped up to take on new responsibilities at the OWIS Whitefield Investiture Ceremony, with Major Braj Bhushan Jha joining us as our Chief Guest.

#OWISWhitefield #InvestitureCeremony #StudentLeadership #YoungLeaders #OWIS #IBSchool #InternationalSchool #BangaloreSchools

[OWIS Whitefield, Investiture Ceremony, Major BrajBhushan Jha, student leadership, young leaders, IB school, international school, Bangalore school]

🎉🎉 Our 25th anniversary year has officially begun!⁣
⁣
From 48 students in a single campus to a global network of 64 campuses across 11 countries and 45,000 students — GSG25 is a celebration of everything we've built together, and everything still ahead. 🌏⁣
⁣
Graced by the presence of Singapore Minister for Law and Second Minister for Home Affairs Mr Edwin Tong, India's High Commissioner to Singapore His Excellency Shilpak Ambule, Ambassadors from various countries, and leaders from different industries — our opening ceremony at Punggol HQ was an event to remember.⁣
⁣
Student-led exhibitions, our commemorative anniversary book launch, and a glimpse of student innovation shaping the future. Plus, S$100,000 committed to community causes across Singapore and 20 new campuses on the way by 2030. 💛⁣
⁣
Thank you to every student, parent, teacher, and community who's been part of this journey. Here's to the year ahead! 🎂⁣
